target_claim: The claimed equivalence that a locale isomorphism is precisely the opposite of some frame homomorphism.
source_quote:
By definition of [[Definition:Locale Isomorphism|locale isomorphism]]:
:$f$ is a [[Definition:Locale Isomorphism|locale isomorphism]]
{{iff}}:
:$f = h^{\text{op}}$ for some [[Definition:Frame Homomorphism|frame homomorphism]]
